Heat Resistant Welding Gloves

<!--Product Code:--> 021300302141040

  • Description

Heat Resistant Leather can resist more than 100 deg Celsius, Proban fabric Liner for heat or fire resistant, Proban-treated fabrics can withstand temperatures up to around 260°C (500°F) without igniting, Proban fabric is 100% cotton or cotton blends, Aramid Thread, Wing Thumb, Four Tips.

Available gloves sizing :

Product Detail: 

Heat Resistant Welding Gloves Key Features:

Heat Resistant Leather: The gloves are constructed entirely from full heat resistant leather, providing a robust barrier against extreme temperatures and sparks. This premium leather offers outstanding durability and flexibility, ensuring your hands remain protected while allowing for natural movement.

Proban Fabric Liner: Inside the gloves, a full Proban fabric liner adds an additional layer of heat and fire resistance. Proban fabric is specially treated to enhance its flame-retardant properties, ensuring that the gloves offer maximum protection in high-heat and fire-prone environments.

Aramid Thread: The gloves are stitched with aramid thread, known for its exceptional heat resistance and strength. This thread ensures that the seams remain intact and durable, even under extreme temperatures and heavy use.

Wing Thumb Design: The wing thumb design enhances flexibility and dexterity, allowing for a better grip and easier movement. This ergonomic feature ensures that you can handle tools and materials with precision and ease.

Four Tips: The gloves feature reinforced tips on the fingers for added durability and protection. This design provides extra resistance to wear and tear, ensuring that the gloves maintain their integrity over time.

Versatile Applications:

Heat Applications: These gloves are specifically engineered for high-temperature environments, making them ideal for welding, foundry work, metalworking, and other heat-intensive tasks. The combination of heat resistant leather and Proban fabric ensures maximum protection against heat and fire.

Welding: Designed with welders in mind, these gloves offer the perfect balance of protection, dexterity, and comfort. The heat resistant properties and durable construction make them essential for any welding task, from MIG and TIG to arc welding.

General High-Temperature Work: Beyond welding, these gloves are suitable for any application involving high temperatures and fire risks. Whether you’re working in a forge, handling hot materials, or performing maintenance in high-heat environments, these gloves provide the protection you need.

Product Specifications:

Material: Entire heat resistant leather for comprehensive protection

Liner: Whole Proban fabric liner for enhanced heat and fire resistance

Thread: Aramid thread for high heat resistance and durability

Design Features: Wing thumb for enhanced dexterity, four tips for reinforced protection

Color: Natural leather tones with durable stitching

Care Instructions:

To maintain the quality and performance of Our Premium Heat Resistant Leather Welding Gloves, follow these care instructions:

Cleaning: Gently brush off any debris or dust. If necessary, wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid soaking the gloves or using harsh chemicals.

Drying: Allow the gloves to air dry naturally, away from direct heat sources and sunlight. Do not wring or tumble dry.

Storage: Store the gloves in a cool, dry place when not in use. Avoid crushing or folding to maintain their shape and integrity.
